name: portfolio-cv-andres-arzamendia
description: Portafolio/CV profesional con panel de administración

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup:backend: npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run prisma:migrate -- --name init
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
